messages:
Maya: @Priya (Legal) quick intake — Ambrosia-7B model we want to bring up. Need license + quant/compliance check before we spin up a spike.
Sam: link to model + license?
Maya: https://models.example/ambrosia7b.tar.gz (license PDF attached in intake form)
Maya: license name appears to be `Ambrosia-ML-1.0`. Key language: "No commercial redistribution or rehosting without explicit consent."
Priya (Legal): I skimmed the PDF — redistribution/rehosting clause is pretty strict. Need to confirm whether serving via API counts as rehosting.
Jonah: Historically we treat "rehosting" as sharing raw weights. API hosting usually allowed unless license explicitly forbids serving.
Priya (Legal): There's also this snippet: ```You may not create derivative models that are made publicly available without permission.``` That might include quantized variants if those are published.
Li: Operational note: For Private/Dedicated customers we sometimes copy model binaries into customer VPCs. That could be considered redistribution. We'll need vendor permission in that case.
Tessa: For Hosted API we keep weights inside our infra and clients call the API only. Ambiguity remains though.
Sam: Any export control or provenance flags we should worry about?
ops-bot: quick-export-scan: no explicit EAR/ITAR tags found in the metadata. Training data provenance unknown.
Priya (Legal): Action items to confirm with upstream: 1) Does "rehosting" include API-based hosting? 2) Are quantized weights treated as derivatives? 3) Any export-control or third-party data restrictions?
Maya: Meanwhile can we run quantization internally (no publishing) and run evals? Plan: 4-bit and 8-bit sweeps on private infra, no external distribution.
Jonah: OK to run internal quant experiments if we don't publish weights. I'll run baseline + 4-bit/8-bit and produce artifacts. Will include: instruction-following eval, hallucination prompts, latency p95, and token-efficiency metrics.
Jonah: Suggest adding regression tests: instruction-following delta, safety category counts, and a small reranking quality set.
Li: Security/ops checklist: if we persist any KV cache snapshots or model checkpoints, encrypt via KMS and restrict key policy. For Dedicated/Private with customer-managed keys, suggest HSM option.
Tessa: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- P95 latency < 150ms @ 8k context on Dedicated small pool
- <= 5% degradation in instruction-following score vs our Llama-v2-7b baseline
- No introduction of new high-risk safety categories in safety eval
- Quantized model artifact size <= 5GB for 4-bit profile
Sam: Prioritization note: Business impact = medium, Compliance risk = medium (license ambiguous). Recommend gating Hosted offering until legal confirms.
Maya: I'll ping upstream authors now and share their reply. Jonah — can you kick off the quant jobs in a forked infra and restrict artifacts to internal S3 folder?
Jonah: Yep. Will lock S3 ACLs and mark artifacts internal-only. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial sweep.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft the clarification email and cc Maya. If they explicitly allow API serving but not redistribution, Hosted is ok; if they also forbid derivative-publication then we must avoid publishing quantized weights to customers.
Maya: Checklist I'm tracking here:
- [ ] Legal clarification sent (Priya)
- [ ] Internal quant experiments started (Jonah)
- [ ] Eval harness run + artifacts uploaded (Jonah)
- [ ] Ops risk doc for Private/Dedicated hosting (Li)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria sign-off (Tessa)
Sam: Please tag the intake in the model tracker as `compliance-gate` and set priority to P2.
Maya: pinging @Priya (Legal) :wave:
Priya (Legal): On it, sending now.
ops-bot: Thread archived into intake/ambrosia7b on 1918203710 :lock:
